map: LOC 12th Army Group situation map, 20 Dec 1944

units.result: record [6.25, 50.29]  reader [6.18, 50.38]  11 km  DIFFERS  note: Hatched infantry box with XX and 18, east of the St Vith line, south of Malmedy.

readerNotes.line: Traced along the heavy ticked line from the top edge, around Aachen and Monschau, the Elsenborn and Malmedy shoulder, west to the Ambleve near the 30th, around the St Vith salient, west around the Bastogne front and the Wiltz loop, then through Luxembourg to the Moselle and southeast to the east edge. Points are sampled evenly along the line.
